title: Rust: Consensus Algorithm
description: Implement a simple consensus algorithm for distributed agreement.

steps.title: Node State
steps.description: Define a `RaftNode` struct with `id: u32, term: u64, voted_for: Option<u32>, state: NodeState` (enum: Follower, Candidate, Leader). Create 3 nodes and print their state.
hints: `struct RaftNode { id: u32, term: u64, voted_for: Option<u32>, state: NodeState }`
All nodes start as Follower with term=0.

verification.failureMessage: Create 3 nodes and print their initial state.

steps.title: Leader Election (Simplified)
steps.description: Implement a simplified leader election: a candidate increments term, votes for itself, and sends vote requests. If it gets majority votes, it becomes leader. Simulate with nodes in a Vec.
hints: Request votes from other nodes (simulate with function calls).

verification.failureMessage: Run an election and print which node becomes leader.

steps.title: Log Replication
steps.description: Add a `log: Vec<String>` to each node. The leader appends entries to its log. Implement a simplified `AppendEntries` RPC that sends log entries to followers. Print replicated log entries.
hints: Leader sends `AppendEntries` to followers (simulated function call).
Followers append the entries to their own log.

verification.failureMessage: Leader appends an entry, replicate to followers, print all logs.

steps.title: Term and Election Safety
steps.description: Add election safety: if a node receives a request with a higher term, it becomes Follower and updates its term. A candidate can only win if its log is at least as up-to-date as the voter's.
hints: If `request.term > self.term`, become Follower and update term.
Compare log length and last term for log up-to-date check.
This ensures the elected leader has the most complete log.

verification.failureMessage: Simulate a higher-term request and show the node steps down.

steps.title: Full Consensus Simulation
steps.description: Run a full simulation: 3 nodes, elect a leader, replicate 3 log entries, handle a leader failure (simulate), and elect a new leader. Print the state after each step.
hints: Phase 3: simulate leader failure (remove from pool).
Phase 4: elect new leader from remaining nodes.

verification.failureMessage: Run the full simulation and print states after each phase.
